behaviors_asserted: Hot Module Replacement (HMR) should update route handlers during development so files can be changed without restarting the server.
On re-registering a route, Hono routers should replace the old handler with the new one.
Currently re-registering a route throws the error: "Can not add a route since the matcher is already built."
In development, re-registering the same route should not error; however adding a new route after the matcher is built should still produce an error.

values_specified.matcher_already_built_error: Can not add a route since the matcher is already built.
